subject: a white wall calendar with a spiral top and an empty grid, absolutely no numbers or letters
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. New Shine educational picture, match the three approved anchors which are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. 1024x1024 transparent PNG. Required dominant color/form: blanco. Recognizable as Spanish word calendario when seen alone at 110 points. Flat colors, no highlights, gradients or textures. Full body for people unless hint says otherwise, friendly, vary natural skin tones; female bailarina, animadora, pitonisa, alternate others. No text, digits, labels, logos, watermarks, arrows, speech bubbles or weapons. Integral parts and explicitly requested plural or compound subjects are allowed, no unrequested objects or scenery. Animal anatomy/limb count is not a rejection criterion. 
Flat vector illustration of a single a white wall calendar with a spiral top and an empty grid, absolutely no numbers or letters, children's educational flashcard style.
Clean continuous dark charcoal (#1E1E2E) outline of uniform medium weight, simple rounded shapes,
flat colors with at most one flat shade per color, no gradients, no textures.
The object keeps its natural, most recognizable colors. Whole object visible, centered,
front or three-quarter view, occupying about 70% of the canvas with clear margins on all sides.
Transparent background. No scene, no ground, no cast shadow, no frame, no border.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no hands, no extra objects.
Friendly, calm, modern picture-book look; consistent with the reference images.
Fix previous candidates: Make a WALL calendar, a single white vertical hanging sheet with spiral binding at top and a blank month grid. No tabletop tent, no rear support, no stand. Empty cells with no numbers or letters. White must dominate.
